chk_scale.note: FLAG: no caliper or operator dimensions (scan-only, DECISIONS.md MEASUREMENTS). Units assumed mm, scale unverified; no scale applied.

primary.desc: back cover floor (flat rear face inside the rim wall)
primary.why: the back cover is the board plane: the three button axes, the screw-boss holes and the connector shroud are all normal to it; largest clean moulded flat (logos excluded by the RANSAC trim)

xy.desc: middle button collar (housing bore boss around the espresso-2-cups button)
xy.why: housing feature that guides the middle button; the part is mirror-symmetric about it (side buttons at +/-27 mm). The loose button cap itself sits 1.6 deg tilted in its bore and is rougher (circle rms 0.03-0.08), so it is not used as the datum

origin.definition: middle button collar axis ∩ back cover floor plane

clock.desc: +X end face of the housing rim/steps (end nearest the steam button) -> +X
clock.why: the housing long axis (line of the three buttons) is X; the end walls are its normals

landmarks.name: mounting tab top face (highest point)
landmarks.tol_source: planes survey peak bin (0.1 mm) + 2x noise floor

landmarks.name: middle button top face centre (median, r<3 mm)
landmarks.tol_source: planes survey peak bin (-29.05 provisional frame, +0.07 frame offset) + 2x noise floor
